effects.subject: COVER SELECTION: A STATEMENT
effects.text: The committee has voted. The senior panorama will be reproduced as shot. The horizon is not level. I have been advised that this is a 'design choice.' I have put that in writing so that I can live with it. For the record, the vote was 2 to 1, and the first 40 minutes of my vote were no. The photographer will receive her credit in a size that is legible. Contact sheets are still due Friday at 3:00. Green. ~Yvette (Class President, hopefully)
